Return approved drugs indicated for cardiovascular disease. Select ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES, indication EFO ID, indication label, and max phase for indication. Source molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, and compound_structures. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Filter for max_phase_for_ind equal to 4 and indication label equal to 'cardiovascular disease'. Sort by ChEMBL ID ascending.
